library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# Fetch server data from database
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../assets/data/site_data.db")
server <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT * FROM servers
  WHERE server_name = 'PROD-DB-02'
")
dbDisconnect(con)

## Description

Hot standby production database server configured for synchronous replication and automatic failover. Maintains an exact real-time copy of PROD-DB-01 ensuring business continuity during hardware failures or maintenance. Can be promoted to primary within seconds minimizing potential downtime. Also serves read-only queries to distribute database load and improve application response times. Critical component of our disaster recovery strategy with RPO of zero.
:::
:::
:::

## Server Specifications

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(DT)

# Create the specs data for the table
specs_data <- data.frame(
  Specification = c("Server Name", "Environment", "CPU Cores", "RAM (GB)",
                    "Storage (TB)", "Uptime (%)", "Current Load (%)",
                    "Location", "Status", "Health", "Total Capacity Score"),
  Value = c(
    server$server_name,
    server$environment,
    as.character(server$cpu_cores),
    as.character(server$ram_gb),
    as.character(server$storage_tb),
    paste0(round(server$uptime_pct, 2), "%"),
    paste0(server$current_load_pct, "%"),
    server$location,
    server$status,
    server$health,
    as.character(round(server$total_capacity_score, 2))
  )
)

datatable(specs_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 15,
            searching = FALSE,
            ordering = FALSE,
            dom = 't',
            columnDefs = list(list(width = '40%', targets = 0),
                             list(width = '60%', targets = 1))
          ),
          colnames = c("", ""),
          rownames = FALSE,
          class = 'cell-border stripe')
```
